🏆 12U Championship — Division 1

8Min Halves
2Min Half Time
2Min Between Games

Competition Format

UPNA 12 Black competes in Championship (Division 1).

The competition runs in two phases:

Phase 1 Preliminary Rounds
Preliminary Pools
→
Phase 2 Ranking Rounds
Ranking Pools
→
Final Overall Position
Points Awarded

Teams are placed into Ranking Pools based on Preliminary Round results and play all other teams in their Ranking Pool. Ranking Pools determine the overall finishing position.

Championship positions: 1st through to 36th, across 5 Ranking Pools (A–E).

⚠️ Updated Playoff Structure

Due to team withdrawals within the 12 Championship division, the Playoff structure has changed. The updated Playoff divisions are now:

Playoff 1–8 8 teams
Playoff 9–16 8 teams
Playoff 17–24 8 teams
Playoff 25–30 6 teams
Playoff 31–36 6 teams

As part of this change:

  • 1st & 2nd placed 8th-ranked teams in the Preliminary Pools progress to Pool D (Playoff 25–30).
  • 3rd & 4th placed 8th-ranked teams in the Preliminary Pools progress to Pool E (Playoff 31–36).
